name: Kakamega Forest: Lirhanda Hill
why: The last rainforest of Kenya: before dawn up Lirhanda Hill to see the sun rise over the canopy, then birds and monkeys on the way down.
book: KWS or Kenya Forest Service fee at Buyangu or Isecheno; walk with a local guide.

points.name: Isecheno forest station
points.note: Forest station and guest houses inside the forest.

points.name: Lirhanda Hill
points.note: A rocky hill above the canopy, best at sunrise.
